allowed: You may call the Generative Language API programmatically, including from autonomous or agent-driven tools.
You own your prompts and outputs and may use them for commercial purposes.
You may use official SDKs and CLI tooling for automated workloads on the paid tier.
forbidden: You must not circumvent rate limits or service quotas.
You must not reverse engineer the models or services.
You must not generate unlawful or harmful content under the Gemini API prohibited-use terms.
retention: On the paid tier Google states it does not use prompts/outputs to improve its products, but free-tier content may be used for improvement including human review (as of the verification date).
training: No training on paid-tier API data by default; free-tier data may be used to improve Google products.
